description: Original hand-authored known-limit probes. The same eight sources and labels informed v2 repairs; these are regression cases, not an independent holdout.

cases.rationale: Template interpolation is masked together with literal template text.
Optional call syntax is outside the current regex.
Default-import Node alias is not modeled.
Lambda varargs shadow a builtin; current lambda visitor does not bind varargs.

cases.source:
import pickle
values = [pickle.loads(blob) for pickle in adapters]
cases.rationale: Comprehension target shadows the module; scope is not modeled.
A method called eval is not the global JavaScript builtin.
The lexical slash heuristic misses regex after return.
Node alias reassignment is not modeled; the custom adapter method is not a known shell API.
